description: Find every domain that uses a specific MX server, with first-/last-seen dates. Use this when sweeping for domains that share a phishing-friendly mail provider, or to map an organisation's mail-handling fleet. Do NOT use this for nameservers (use `reverse_ns`) or for hosting IPs (use `reverse_ip`).

from_needle.description: Pagination needle from previous response. Max 300 records per page.

include_additional_checks.description: If true, performs wildcard and domain activeness checks. Extra cost.

preview.description: If true, returns just the domain names without additional information.

name: reverse_mx
